srs: The police intake system records Complainant, IntakeForm, RegistrationModule, and PoliceUnit; each has an id attribute. Each Complainant can have zero or more IntakeForm records, and each IntakeForm belongs to exactly one Complainant. Each IntakeForm uses exactly one RegistrationModule, and each RegistrationModule serves zero or more IntakeForm records. Each RegistrationModule manages one or more PoliceUnit records by composition, and each PoliceUnit belongs to exactly one RegistrationModule. Each Complainant can reference zero or more PoliceUnit records, and each PoliceUnit can be referenced by zero or more Complainant records.
